_meta.purpose: Multi-market availability source registry for automated rent scrapes. Each submarket lists buildings with a URL + extraction method. Journal Square is synced from the dedicated upstream pipeline rather than re-scraped here.

methods.sightmap_api: GET SightMap JSON API (same-origin embed token → API path).
methods.rose_widget: Playwright DOM extract on availability.rosenyc.com widget.
methods.modern_spaces: Playwright DOM extract on newdev.modernspacesnyc.com frame.
methods.dom_read: Playwright evaluate against marketing-site availability page.
methods.manual_json: Operator pastes unit rows; no live fetch.

submarkets.name: Journal Square
submarkets.notes: Do not re-scrape here — the upstream Playwright extractors are the source of truth (13 buildings). Use sync-journal-square.mjs.

buildings.name: Example SightMap building (template)
buildings.notes: Copy this template; set enabled:true + real SightMap API path when onboarding a Downtown JC comp.
